caveats: 4 cycles, but two (Jun-10 and Mar-14) were aborted within 1-9 months -- Jun-10 reversed by Mar-11 (Christchurch quake emergency cut), Mar-14 unwound from mid-2015. Average move and endpoint paths are biased toward reversal scenarios; treat sim-weighted result as an upper bound on persistence.
Cash uses NDSWAP (3M BKBM swaps), forwards use SD0015FS (OIS / Dual-Curve). BKBM-OIS basis is small but residual; carry differences of a few bp can show up.
10Y NDSWAP data is reliable from 2000, so all four cycles have full curve depth -- effective N on similarity weighting is the binding constraint, not data history.
